classification.difficultyReason: Find the common perimeter from a regular hexagon, then solve for the side length of a regular octagon.

content.prompt: The perimeter of the regular hexagon and the regular octagon is equal. Work out the side length of the regular octagon.

spec.description: Horizontal pair with an unfilled regular hexagon on the left and an unfilled regular octagon on the right, both with black outlines. Both have horizontal top and bottom sides. The hexagon's top side is labelled 4 cm in black. Decorative source fills and colours are intentionally omitted.
spec.mathematics: The hexagon has six equal sides of 4 cm. The octagon has eight equal sides and the same perimeter. Figure sizes do not assert equal drawn perimeters.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the supplied 4 cm label is visible; the octagon side length remains unlabelled.

answer.worked:
The hexagon's perimeter is
$\begin{aligned}P&=6\times4\\P&=24\text{ cm}\end{aligned}$
Let $x$ be the octagon's side length in centimetres.
$\begin{aligned}P&=8x\\24&=8x\\x&=3\end{aligned}$
The side length is $3\text{ cm}$.
